data.title: New Zealand King Salmon director updates disclosure of trust-linked share interests
data.description:
New Zealand King Salmon Investments ( (NZ:NZK) ) has shared an announcement.

New Zealand King Salmon director Jack Lee Porus has updated his disclosure of relevant interests in the company’s ordinary shares, correcting aspects of a prior notice. The filing details his indirect joint power over NZK shares through the Harbour View Trust and related entities, reflecting governance-related shareholdings rather than a change in his personal economic exposure.

The notice records that Harbour View Investments Limited acquired 15,000 NZK shares via two on-market trades in September 2023, lifting the holdings subject to Porus’s indirect joint control from 60,800 to 75,800 shares. It also reiterates substantial holdings held in trust structures, including more than 6.7 million shares via the Porus Holdings Trust and additional shares via the Auckland Private Education Charitable Trust, underscoring the significance of trust-based ownership in the company’s shareholder base.

data.title: CL Educate Sets September 29 Virtual AGM, Issues FY26 Annual Report Digitally
data.description:

The meeting notice and the company’s Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26, including audited standalone and consolidated financial statements, the Board’s report, corporate governance report and management discussion and analysis, have been dispatched electronically to shareholders with registered email addresses.

The company will separately inform shareholders without registered email IDs by sending letters that provide a web link and navigation path to access the full Annual Report online.
